notes: A SECOND PERSON FOR RE-PAYING A STALE CHEQUE; STAFF LOANS KEPT TO THEIR PAYOUT; BILLS AND INVOICES POSTED ONLY FROM THEIR OWN SCREENS. Paying a reinstated cheque again (Pay…), or clearing the stale-cheques balance any other way, now needs a second person's approval, names its cheques and equals exactly what they are owed; the Approval Centre shows each cheque's history. A presented cheque cannot be reinstated; staleness counts from the payment's date; cheque numbers are compared by their digits. Staff loans are lent through + New loan, written off only to an ordinary expense account, and payroll waits while a write-off is unfinished. Bills and invoices are posted only from their own screens, and a note never pays money out. Also: an unsaved-changes warning on every editor, Inventory Adjust value, Year-End tie-out and seals on the checklist, quotes need lines. The Help guide covers all of it. Installing: database changes (0230–0254) that alter no posted figure. Please take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now. Carries everything in 0.6.147.
